definitions.explanation: The quality of refusing to give in despite difficulties, opposition, or hardship. Used as a noun or as a の-modifier.

examples.japanese: {不屈|ふくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: To fight with an indomitable spirit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不屈|ふくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: She overcame her illness with unyielding willpower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧{不屈|ふくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The indomitable attitude of never giving up despite repeated failures moved many people.

notes:
A compound of {不|ふ} (not) and {屈|くつ} (yield, bend). Literally "not yielding." Almost always used as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modifier before abstract nouns like ⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧, ⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧, or ⟦{闘志|とうし}→闘志：19440_toushi⟧.

USAGE:
Rarely used alone as a standalone noun; it almost always modifies another word. The phrase {不屈|ふくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (indomitable spirit) is particularly common and iconic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不屈|ふくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ — indomitable spirit
- {不屈|ふくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧ — unyielding will
- {不屈|ふくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{闘志|とうし}→闘志：19440_toushi⟧ — dauntless fighting spirit
- {不屈|ふくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ — relentless effort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頑強|がんきょう} — tenacious, stubborn (strong resistance)
- ⟦{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い→粘り強い：07165_nebarizuyoi⟧ — tenacious, persistent (sustained effort)
- {不撓不屈|ふとうふくつ} — indomitable and unbending (four-character compound, more literary)
